notes.raw:
\*Data except enthalpy of formation at 298 K estimated. Phase changes: 980 K, $\alpha-\beta$ transition point of Mn; $\Delta H^{\circ}=0.532$ kcal/mol. 1360 K, $\beta-\gamma$ transition point of Mn; $\Delta H^{\circ}=0.507$ kcal/mol. 1410 K, $\gamma-\delta$ transition point of Mn; $\Delta H^{\circ}=0.449$ kcal/mol. 1517 K, melting point of Mn; $\Delta H^{\circ}=2.882$ kcal/mol. Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations: 298.15-2000 K: $Cp^{0} = 8.877 + 0.032 \times 10^{-3} T - 0.627 \times 10^{5} T^{-2}$ $H^{0} - H_{298}^{0} = 8.877 \times 10^{-3} T + 0.016 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} + 0.627 \times 10^{2} T^{-1} - 2.858$ Reaction equations (kcal/mol):
298.15-980 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = 50.104 - 0.933x10^{-3}T - 1.851x10^{-6}T^{2} - 4.850T^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = 50.104 + 0.933x10^{-3}T\ln T + 1.851x10^{-6}T^{2} - 2.425T^{-1} - 29.834x10^{-3}T$
980-1360 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = 50.523 - 3.113x10^{-3}T - 0.708x10^{-6}T^{2} + 81.950T^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = 50.523 + 3.113x10^{-3}T\ln T + 0.708x10^{-6}T^{2} + 40.975T^{-1} - 44.208x10^{-3}T$
1360-1410 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = 50.550 - 2.885x10^{-3}T - 1.144x10^{-6}T^{2} + 28.550T^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = 50.550 + 2.885x10^{-3}T\ln T + 1.144x10^{-6}T^{2} + 14.275T^{-1} - 43.154x10^{-3}T$
1410-1517 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = 50.802 - 3.473x10^{-3}T - 1.079x10^{-6}T^{2} + 28.550T^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = 50.802 + 3.473x10^{-3}T\ln T + 1.079x10^{-6}T^{2} + 14.275T^{-1} - 47.513x10^{-3}T$
1517-2000 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = 50.048 - 6.294x10^{-3}T - 0.144x10^{-6}T^{2} + 28.550T^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = 50.048 + 6.294x10^{-3}T\ln T + 0.144x10^{-6}T^{2} + 14.275T^{-1} - 66.259x10^{-3}T$
Source: Data from Mills (80) who estimated all except enthalpy of formation at 298 K.
